article.headline: Insmed Soars 16.2% On Report Sanofi Weighs A Takeover
article.deck: The jump carries Insmed past the 137.80 buy point of a 15-week cup, and at 139.17 it trades 1.0% above it, inside the buy range that runs to 144.69.
body: Insmed gained 19.37 to 139.17, up 16.2%, as of 8:52 a.m. Mountain, and is on pace for 9.99x its 50-day average volume. The move takes the stock through the 137.80 buy point of a 15-week cup that topped on Aug. 6 and bottomed on Oct. 23, a 32.7% correction. The buy range runs to 144.69, and the stock sits 1.0% past the buy point. That cup formed after a bigger slide, so the stock is still 34.6% under the 212.75 high it set on Dec. 2, 2025.

The gap lifts Insmed 25.7% above its 50-day line at 110.75 and 13.5% above its 200-day line at 122.58. It trades 20.4% above its 21-day exponential line at 115.60. Because the session's low held above that line, the reading is 0.36 ATRs from the 21-day line, which is not stretched by that measure. The stock ranks 91 of 99 on the desk's list for relative strength, though the RS line is still 38.5% below its high. Shares are up 48.0% over the past month and down 20.0% year to date.

The company still loses money, but revenue has climbed every quarter in the table: 263.8 million, 306.0 million, 425.5 million and then 524.4 million in the September quarter, up 268.4% from a year earlier. The September quarter loss was 0.46 a share. Insmed carries a market value of about 30.58 billion and a forward P/E of 217.16.

Reuters reported Thursday that Sanofi weighs a takeover of Insmed, citing Bloomberg News. Two days earlier a MarketBeat headline said Insmed sees Brinsupri reaching 7 billion in peak sales and expects a cash-flow positive year ahead.
A close back under 137.80 would put the breakout in stalled territory on the first day.
article.watch: Whether Insmed holds above the 137.80 buy point into the close, with 144.69 the top of the buy range.

article.headline: Rubrik Jumps 7.7% As Oppenheimer Expects Beat-And-Raise Quarter
article.deck: Rubrik has no base on the desk's chart; today's move is a bounce off the 50-day line, not an entry from a pattern, and earnings are due Nov. 30.
body: Rubrik rose 8.52 to 118.52, up 7.7%, as of 8:52 a.m. Mountain, on pace for 2.9x its 50-day average volume. The stock pulled back to its 50-day line at 115.19 and is lifting off it. The desk finds no base and no buy point on the chart, so there is no buy range to measure against.

Rubrik trades 2.9% above the 50-day line, 4.5% above its 21-day exponential line at 113.41, and 48.0% above its 200-day line at 80.06. The session's low held above the 21-day line, a reading of 0.2 ATRs from the 21-day line, so the move is not stretched. The stock is 15.3% under its 52-week high of 139.92. It ranks 99 of 99 on the desk's list for relative strength, with the RS line 7.5% below its high. Shares are up 55.0% year to date and 72.3% over the past year.

Revenue for the quarter ended July 31 was 427.3 million, up 37.9% from a year earlier, rising from 350.2 million four quarters back. The company posted a loss of 0.30 a share in that quarter. Rubrik is worth about 24.39 billion and trades at a forward P/E of 152.86. The next report is due Nov. 30.
An MT Newswires headline on Tuesday said Oppenheimer expects Rubrik to deliver a beat-and-raise fiscal third quarter.
A close back under the 50-day line would undo the bounce; a new base after the report would give the chart a buy point.

article.headline: CrowdStrike Climbs 5.7% As Palo Alto Results Lift Cybersecurity Stocks
article.deck: CrowdStrike bounces off its 50-day line inside a six-week cup with a 287.09 buy point, 12.7% above the price; the desk's early entry is above today's high at 256.83.
body: CrowdStrike gained 13.52 to 250.55, up 5.7%, as of 8:52 a.m. Mountain, on pace for 2.24x its 50-day average volume. The stock dipped to its 50-day line at 246.73 and turned up. It sits in a six-week cup that topped on Oct. 6 and bottomed on Nov. 5, a 25.7% correction. The buy point is 287.09 with a buy range to 301.44, and the stock trades 12.7% under it.

The desk flags an aggressive entry off the 50-day bounce: a move above today's high at 256.83, 2.4% above the current price, with the 50-day line as the stop. The stock is 1.5% above the 50-day line and 5.8% above its 21-day exponential line at 236.74, a reading of 0.53 ATRs from the 21-day line. The 52-week high is 286.99. CrowdStrike ranks 99 of 99 on the desk's list for relative strength, and its RS line is 3.6% from its high. Shares are up 113.8% year to date.

Revenue in the quarter ended July 31 was 1.47 billion, up 25.8% from a year earlier, after 1.23 billion, 1.31 billion and 1.39 billion in the three quarters before it. Earnings were 0.01 a share, down from 0.03 and 0.04 in the two prior quarters. The company is valued at about 256.26 billion with a forward P/E of 155.33. Earnings are due Dec. 1.

The move comes as Palo Alto Networks soars on its first-quarter earnings and an Applied Compute deal; one headline cited a guidance hike and a 4.5 billion AI deal, and another said Palo Alto's results lift cybersecurity peers.
A close back under the 50-day line would cancel the early entry.

article.headline: Palo Alto Networks Jumps 8.6% Premarket On $4.5 Billion Startup Deal
article.deck: The premarket price of 369.20 puts the stock back over its 50-day line, but it is still well under the 432.43 buy point of a six-week, 30.3% deep cup, and that buy point is the level to watch.
body: Palo Alto Networks traded at 369.20 before the open, up 29.28, or 8.6%, as of 8:50 a.m. Eastern. That came on top of Wednesday, when the stock closed at 339.92, up 30.63, or 9.9%, and traded 2.83x its 50-day average volume. The chart is a six-week cup, 30.3% deep, with a rim on Oct. 6 and a low on Nov. 17. The buy point is 432.43 and the buy range runs to 454.05. Wednesday's close sat 21.4% below the buy point.

The 52-week high is 432.33, and the close was 21.4% under it. Wednesday's close was 0.5% below the 21-day exponential average at 341.75, 0.0 ATRs from the 21-day line, with a 14-day ATR of 19.52. The close was 7.3% under the 50-day line at 366.70; the premarket price is above that level. The stock holds 21.6% over its 200-day line at 279.47. It ranks 96 of 99 on the desk's list for relative strength, and the RS line is 13.6% off its high. The stock is up 84.5% this year and 67.5% over the past year.

The quarter ended July 31 brought a loss of 35 cents a share against a profit a year earlier, an EPS change of -197.2%, on revenue of $3.41 billion, up 34.4%. EPS ran 0.47, 0.61, -0.22 and -0.35 over the four quarters given, while revenue climbed each quarter from $2.474 billion. The market values the company at about $278.3 billion, at 69.3 times forward earnings. The next earnings date is Feb. 16, 2027.

24/7 Wall St. reported that Palo Alto is paying $4.5 billion for a startup founded last year by former OpenAI researchers. An Investing.com premarket roundup has Palo Alto soaring as chip stocks rally ahead of the Anthropic debut.
A move back over the 50-day line that holds would leave the right side of the cup to finish; a slip back under the 21-day line at 341.75 would undo most of the premarket gap.
article.watch: Whether the gap holds above the 50-day line at 366.70 once the session opens.

The 52-week high is 48.93, 58.4% above the close. The stock closed 15.1% under its 21-day exponential average at 23.98, -0.99 ATRs from the 21-day line, with a 14-day ATR of 1.99.
